context:
Goal: the feedback guard counts a repeated heading with the same time and quote as one message, and still blocks a missed owner send.
Problem (rule): round 3 judged PR #3218's net safety value negative. It closes a false alarm but a [page], [repo] or grant [page] item under the second copy skips the owner-send check, which main blocked once. A negative-net change is parked with no fix lane until you decide.
Based on (probe): reviewer probes on scratch copies of main and head with one owner record and no send; the gap is in hooks/feedback_guard.py:969, 989, 993.
Based on (ruling): decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3; R9 keeps the net-value test only for an unclear case that cannot finish.
Departs from: main — a held change gets no fix lane; this lets one fix lane run.
Meanwhile: the PR stays parked, not handed in; the lane works its other steps.

options.gain: The false alarm closes and the missed owner-send check does not open.
options.how: One lane makes seen[text] count only the first copy and gives every copy its k, with red cases for a [page], [repo] and grant [page] item under the second copy. A round-3 fix check follows.
options.label: Allow one fix lane for the small fix, then a round-3 fix check (recommended)
options.lose: A parked change gets a fix lane before you decide, which the net-value hold normally forbids.

options.gain: The hold works as written; nothing changes.
options.how: The change stays parked with no more work until you rule on it.
options.label: Leave PR #3218 parked
options.lose: The false alarm stays: a repeated heading with the same time and quote can still make the Stop hook refuse twice.

reply: Filed 13:21 CST: your 749 a is ruling own-749-a-one-fix-lane. One fix lane may repair PR #3218, then a round-3 fix check. Told the lane and the coordinator.
short: PR #3218: allow one fix lane on a parked, net-negative change?

shown.label: Allow one fix lane for the small fix, then a round-3 fix check (recommended)

title: The held feedback-guard change (PR #3218) closes a false alarm but opens a missed send. May one fix lane repair it?
why: The hold on a negative-net change ends only on your word.
